Inspect a run

Source: R/job.R
dragon_status.Rd

dragon_status() reads the run's state. dragon_progress() returns one row per logged step. dragon_logs() returns the tail of the trainer log.

Usage

dragon_status(run)

dragon_progress(run)

dragon_logs(run, n = 50)

Arguments

run

A dragon_run.

n

Number of log lines to return.

Value

dragon_status(): a list with at least state, one of "queued", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled".

dragon_progress(): a data frame with columns step, epoch, loss, eval_loss, lr, grad_norm, elapsed_s, eta_s.

dragon_logs(): a character vector.
